material_findings.title: Amazon Developer Hackathon — Alexa+ agent/MCP and Open Source mini-challenge
material_findings.entry_cost: No purchase or payment required; AWS charges beyond free usage remain participant responsibility.
material_findings.prize_evidence: $138,000 total cash across Fire TV ($44k), Alexa+ ($44k), Bee ($20k), Ring ($20k), AWS Builder ($5k) and Open Source ($5k). Alexa+ 1st/2nd/3rd $25k/$15k/$4k; Open Source mini $5k. Separate AWS credits are not cash. Prizes subject to official winner verification and terms.
material_findings.eligibility: Adults of age of majority, teams and eligible organizations, subject to geographic/legal and conflicts exclusions; user-specific registration and jurisdiction not verified.
material_findings.submission: Working primary-track app, source repo with setup and license if public (or private with organizer reviewer access), public <3 minute English video, technical integration, and detailed product feedback; disclose substantial changes to existing projects. Alexa+ can use agent skill, self-hosted MCP Streamable HTTP spec >=2025-11-25, or functional simulated experience.
material_findings.source_change: Official rules updated October 7: $150 AWS promotional credit codes exhausted; do not budget them as available. No purchase necessary does not mean cloud spend cannot occur.
material_findings.risk: Over 53,000 Devpost participants on checked listing, so high competition. Reusing suite work requires originality/IP and substantial-update evidence. Do not expose credentials or grant repository access without explicit participant decision.
material_findings.authorization: Build competition only. No authorization to test Amazon services, public targets, or third-party systems. Use documented simulators, test accounts, and permitted APIs.
material_findings.deduplication: No matching Amazon Developer Hackathon canonical intelligence/opportunity entry or open PR title found on current main. General Devpost catalog already exists.
missing_verification: Selected track and functional demo feasibility before October 23
Cloud billing/usage controls; AWS promotional credits unavailable
Project originality, ownership, licenses, pre-existing code change log
Official prize payment forms, tax and individual recipient requirements
material_findings.next_action: Build agent: after protected Aug 30 morning replay and chronology reconciliation, re-open rules; if entrant registered, create a structured build-competition case for a bounded Alexa+ simulated agent/MCP demo with an independently useful open-source contribution and tests. Do not start work that requires unapproved paid cloud services.
